image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming underwater in blue water, viewed from a frontal angle. The distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head) is clearly visible with eyes at the tips. The shark's body is streamlined with visible pectoral fins and dorsal fin. The ventral side appears lighter than the dorsal side.
